simple.meaning: מַלְאָךְ (malʼâk) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “a messenger ; specifically, of God, i.e. an angel (also a prophet, priest or teacher).” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 213 times across Genesis, Exodus, Numbers, Deuteronomy, Joshua, and 3 more, beginning at Genesis 16:7. Its contexts include family line, city, wilderness.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מַלְאָךְ (H4397).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: מַלְאָךְ (malʼâk) / H4397 is traced through Genesis 16:7, Genesis 16:9, Genesis 16:10, Genesis 16:11 as a generated source-based concept entry.
